decisions.rationale: Test full SET_BASED transformation across both loops to establish the best f1 baseline, along with intermediate BULK_500 variants combined with LOOKUP_CACHE to explore memory versus I/O trade-offs across the two loops.
Test BULK with LOOKUP_SQL to reduce memory while cutting gets below ROW; test BULK_5000 to push gets lower; selectively cache only one lookup table to observe memory vs gets trade-off.
Test caching only R2 (s3/s6) vs R1, combine partial caching with low-memory BULK_50, and test SET_BASED with single-lookup caching on s4 to discover tighter intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
Test caching on s1=SET_BASED combined with BULK_50 on s4 to probe intermediate memory, and evaluate single-table caching splits with low bulk sizes.
Test caching only R1 in both loops with BULK/ROW to bridge low-memory gaps, explore ROW+caching trade-offs, and check asymmetric R1/R2 caching under SET_BASED.
Testing ROW with single cache lookups explores low-memory points between 1.8MB and 9MB, while SET_BASED with ROW lookups isolates minimal-overhead partial transitions along the Pareto boundary.
Test caching on s1 alone or low-overhead bulk setups to bridge the Pareto gap between f2=2MB-8MB and f1=5k-78k.
Evaluating combinations where R1 cache is isolated, or testing SET_BASED with BULK_5000 / ROW with BULK combinations to identify frontier trade-offs between 7800KB and 18400KB PGA.
Test full set-based execution for optimal consistent gets, alongside bulk alternatives with varying batch sizes and lookup caching to explore memory vs I/O trade-offs.
Test smaller bulk sizes and selective caching combinations to bridge the trade-off between the low-I/O cached variants and low-PGA SQL-based variants.
Test single-lookup caching (s2/s5 cached vs s3/s6 cached) and hybrid SET_BASED pairings to bridge intermediate f1/f2 trade-offs between 2.4MB and 18MB.
Test caching on R1 across SET_BASED and BULK variants; probe intermediate PGA trade-offs between 2432KB and 7872KB using single-loop caching or asymmetric batching.
Test caching R1 with BULK_50/BULK_500 vs ROW, and test caching R2 with SET_BASED to fill gaps between 7800KB and 18000KB PGA.
Test asymmetrical combinations and BULK_500/ROW mixes with single cache layers (s2/s5 or s3/s6) to find non-dominated trade-offs between f1=4730-78161 and f2=2.4MB-18MB.
Evaluating ROW on s1 or s4 with partial caching, and s1=SET_BASED with s4=ROW single cache to search low-PGA trade-offs near the Pareto frontier.
Evaluating BULK_500 for S1 with SET_BASED S4 and exploring selective cache in S1 or low-memory bulk configurations to find Pareto-optimal trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Test fully SET_BASED execution for maximal I/O reduction, followed by BULK variants with and without lookup caches to establish both extremes and the memory-I/O trade-off frontier.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces f1 at high f2 cost. BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE tests extreme low f1, while caching only one lookup site (R1 or R2) or combining BULK_500 with SQL lookups explores the middle trade-off.
Test caching only R2 or asymmetric caching across loops to discover intermediate memory-buffer trade-offs between pure SQL lookups and full double-table caching.
Explores pairing SET_BASED at s1 with lightweight bulk/lookup options at s4 to find better trade-offs around 70k-110k gets and moderate PGA.
Symmetric designs testing s1=BULK with cache lookups against s4=SET_BASED, plus SET_BASED with s4=BULK_5000 to probe whether larger bulk limits or inverted asymmetry improve the Pareto trade-offs.
Test caching only R2 in SET_BASED + BULK_500/50 to bridge memory gaps, and test asymmetric single-loop caching between s1 and s4 to uncover intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
Test BULK loops with hybrid LOOKUP_CACHE configurations across s1 and s4 to find Pareto points with moderate PGA and low gets.
Explore low memory trade-offs using BULK_500 on one site combined with ROW, and asymmetric single-cache configurations to uncover Pareto improvements around low PGA.
Test extreme points first: full SET_BASED for minimum logical I/O, balanced BULK with caching to assess memory vs I/O trade-offs, and mixed SET_BASED with bulk processing.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts logical I/O at higher PGA. Testing BULK_50 with cache checks if lower memory can be achieved with low f1, while testing caching on single loop or single table explores the memory-I/O trade-off curve.

Caching only R1 yields moderate memory (~9MB). Exploring asymmetric cache allocations and combining SET_BASED with single-cache BULK loops may uncover dominant intermediate trade-offs between 2304KB and 18432KB.
Test caching only R1 or R2 under SET_BASED pairings, and probe asymmetric single-loop cache configurations to refine the trade-off curve between 2.4MB and 7.8MB PGA.
Test caching R1 with BULK_50/ROW and SET_BASED combinations to explore memory below 8MB while lowering consistent gets below 110k.
Evaluating BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_SQL and SET_BASED with LOOKUP_SQL combinations to target the low-memory, moderate-gets Pareto region.
Evaluating ROW on s1 paired with SET_BASED on s4, caching options with ROW/SET_BASED, and exploring minimal PGA states to uncover non-dominated trade-offs between 1856KB and 6592KB.
Test caching R1 with BULK_500 on loop 1 and SET_BASED on loop 2, plus evaluate ROW on loop 1 with BULK_50 on loop 2 for lower-memory frontiers.

Test extreme points first: full SET_BASED across both loops to drastically cut consistent gets, intermediate bulk batch sizes with cached lookups, and one asymmetric bulk/set configuration to explore the Pareto boundary.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically cuts logical I/O at the expense of memory. Testing smaller batch sizes (ROW, BULK_50) with LOOKUP_CACHE and isolating cache across loop pairs will explore the low-gets, moderate-PGA frontier.
Caching one table across loops gives moderate PGA (~9MB) vs all-cached (~20MB). Testing BULK processing combined with single cache lookup explores the dense mid-region between low I/O and low PGA.
Test caching only table R1 or R2 under SET_BASED/BULK hybrid configurations to find optimal tradeoffs between f1 and f2.

Evaluating asymmetric configurations combining SET_BASED with selectively cached lookups to explore intermediate Pareto trade-offs between 2304KB and 7872KB PGA, and BULK_500 with minimal caching to lower f1 without high memory spikes.
Test caching only R1 or R2 across loops with low bulk sizes or single-loop caching to explore the trade-off between 2.3MB and 7.8MB PGA.
Test caching on R2 only (smaller f2 impact than both caches), exploring intermediate f1/f2 trade-offs with SET_BASED and BULK variants.

Test BULK_50/500 with ROW or mixed SET_BASED combinations to probe intermediate PGA/gets trade-offs, specifically targeting unexplored asymmetric caching and low-PGA configurations between 2304KB and 6592KB.
